title: Dance therapy in rehabilitation: a two-decade bibliometric analysis
core_idea: Perform the first longitudinal bibliometric mapping of research on dance therapy in rehabilitation over a two-decade period to identify key research areas, emerging trends, collaborative networks, and thematic evolution using bibliometric tools and databases.
tldr: Systematic bibliometric study using Web of Science and tools (VOSviewer, bibliometrix, Scimago, CiteSpace) to map research themes, collaborations, and emerging trends in dance therapy applied to rehabilitation.
